description:
Deactivate the user account for 'Alex Morgan' (username: amorgan) and update their name to indicate termination. Specifically:
1. Navigate to the User Management section (System / Settings > Access Management > Users).
2. Find the user 'Alex Morgan' (amorgan).
3. Edit the user account.
4. Set 'Active' to No/False to disable login.
5. Append ' (CONTRACT ENDED)' to the user's Last Name (or Name field if single field). The final name should look like 'Alex Morgan (CONTRACT ENDED)'.
6. Save the changes.
